desc: Vote arithmetic: the ballot-counting decision table (Table VIII; 45:31-36) and election-specific rules. Case selection over a Ballot record {marks, sections, folded_with, voter_membership}; 'credited' = to a candidate/choice, 'counted' = toward votes cast for majority computation. The unclear-meaning branch routes through adjudication (ballot-meaning); whether an unclear ballot MAY AFFECT the result is arithmetic: questionable_count >= margin between deciding positions.

ballot_counting.case: overvote (too many candidates for the office)
blank folded with one filled ballot
unidentifiable nonmember ballots possibly affecting result
ballot_counting.effect: entire vote null and void; retake

ballot_counting.rule: each section tallied as an independent ballot; folding creates illegal votes only per duplicated section

elections.multi_seat: every ballot voting in the section = one vote cast; seats fill by majority then vote-total order; ties and shortfalls go to repeated balloting with no forced dropouts [46:32-33]

threshold_evaluation.desc: How a Vote record's result is computed against its threshold (vocabulary.json thresholds).

rules.note: the multiplication form (yes >= 2*no) is exact for votes-cast two-thirds

rules.desc: the objection is SUSTAINED (question not considered) when two thirds vote against consideration
the chair's ruling is REVERSED only on this expression (majority in the negative); tie sustains
the negative is not taken (intrinsically irrelevant); present_count_at_affirmative is the chair's count immediately after the affirmative

threshold_evaluation.note: membership_total is an assembly input field; notice+X compounds evaluate X after verifying the notice event (event-occurred previous-notice within its window)

vote_validity_remedies.desc: Remedies for votes tainted by exclusion of members or inclusion of improper votes — compiled margin arithmetic, not judgment. could-have-affected = the tainted count reaches the margin between the announced positions. On a sustained point of order within the applicable window, the vote is declared invalid and retaken.

rules.case: members denied the right to vote or attend [23:7]

invalid_when.desc: if the excluded votes could have changed the outcome: attackable as long as the decision has continuing force; if they could not: only by a point of order raised immediately after the announcement

rules.residual: where invalidation is unavailable, the debate-influence argument routes through rescind / reconsider / renewal as ordinary motions [23:7]

rules.case: improper votes included — nonmembers, absentees, multiple votes [23:8]
rules.note: unidentifiable nonmember ballots possibly affecting the result void the entire ballot vote (ballot_counting row) [45:35]

schema_addition: Ballot and tally structures are runtime inputs; schema.json Vote.tally carries the aggregate. Per-ballot adjudications appear as AdjudicationInstance records with predicate ballot-meaning.
